resources.string: 9:16 (YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels)
1. Stand in front of a plain, single-colour background. Green works best.
2. Always keep your face in bright light: sunlight, or a white 6500K light like a studio ring light, or even a white LED bulb.
3. Background removal quality depends on your phone\'s GPU, because this app uses a local AI model.
A bright background photo looks more smooth.
Limit reached: delete one to add more
You can add up to %1$d of your own backgrounds. Delete one first to add another.
Your photo will be removed from this app. The original in your gallery isn\'t touched.
Couldn\'t use that photo. Please pick a different JPG, PNG or WebP image.
Wait this long before an auto-publish uploads, so you can cancel it from the card or the notification.
When on, every finished recording is uploaded and published to the channels you chose on the website, with no further taps. Credits are charged by the server.
Not set up yet: set up on the web
No channel is ready to post to: check your channels on the web
Display over other apps (face cam in other apps)
Camera: You press record and talk for ten minutes.\nLater you play the video and you are not in it.\nAllow the camera, so your audience sees your face.
Microphone: You give your best talk, then play it back and hear nothing.\nAllow the microphone, so your voice is in the video.

Display over other apps: Imagine you are talking to your audience and you need to show something from another app.\nThe moment you leave this app, your face cam is gone.\nAllow this, and your face stays on screen while you show other apps.

Notifications: You are showing another app and you want to stop recording.\nWithout this, you must come back here first, and that ends up in your video.\nAllow it, and you stop with one tap from the notification bar.

You press record, then you need a few seconds to open your slides and get ready.\nWithout a countdown, those messy seconds become the start of your video.\nPick a delay, and recording starts when you are ready.

Talking to your audience? Keep the microphone on.
Want to add music or a voice-over later? Choose mute, so no room noise gets into your video.
Is your voice not clear enough? Plug in a headset or a USB microphone and the app uses it right away.
You can switch back to the phone microphone here.

You record one video, but you want to post it on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook.
Each one needs a different shape.
Tick the shapes you need, and after recording you get a ready-to-post copy of each.
Tick nothing, and you have to crop the video yourself in another app.

You are ready to record, but the room behind you is messy.
Or you are in a place you do not want to show.
Turn this on and pick a background.
After recording, the app swaps everything behind you with it, so people see only you and a clean background.
